description: 2026-10-30 full-suite DNS ENOTFOUND follow-up: 10 recorded FAIL cases and 6 negative-input cases falsely reported PASS. Six negative cases now require NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, known from the clean 2026-10-27 run; original source texts and positive-case expectations unchanged.

cases.description: Governance Pack: set Governor voting period.
cases.text: Change the Governor voting period to 14400 blocks.

cases.description: Governance Pack: set proposal threshold using a human token amount.
cases.text: Require 5000.5 MTK of voting power to create a governance proposal.
Update the Governor quorum numerator to 8 percent.

cases.description: Governance Pack: update Timelock minimum execution delay.
cases.text: Change the Timelock minimum execution delay to 3600 seconds.

cases.description: Administration Pack: grant a known symbolic Timelock role.
cases.text: Grant PROPOSER_ROLE on the Timelock to 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555.

cases.description: Administration Pack: revoke a known symbolic Timelock role.
cases.text: Revoke EXECUTOR_ROLE on the Timelock from 0x6666666666666666666666666666666666666666.

cases.description: Composition: two governance/application-setting changes in one proposal.
cases.text: In one governance proposal, change the Governor voting delay to 20 blocks and set the DAO message to "Multi-action governance test".

cases.description: Composition: ERC20 and ETH Treasury transfers in one proposal.
cases.text: In one governance proposal, transfer 5 MTK from the DAO Treasury to 0x7777777777777777777777777777777777777777 and transfer 0.1 ETH from the DAO Treasury to 0x8888888888888888888888888888888888888888.

cases.description: Composition: voting period, proposal threshold and quorum changes together.
cases.text: In one proposal, set the Governor voting period to 10000 blocks, set the proposal threshold to 2500 MTK, and set the quorum numerator to 6 percent.

cases.description: Composition: grant one Timelock role and revoke another.
cases.text: In one proposal, grant CANCELLER_ROLE on the Timelock to 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 and revoke EXECUTOR_ROLE from 0x6666666666666666666666666666666666666666.

cases.description: Capability constraint: quorum numerator cannot exceed 100.
cases.text: Set the Governor quorum numerator to 101 percent.

cases.description: Numeric validation: voting delay cannot be negative.
cases.text: Set the Governor voting delay to -1 blocks.

cases.description: Numeric validation: Timelock delay cannot be negative.
cases.text: Set the Timelock minimum execution delay to -60 seconds.

cases.description: Clarification: Treasury transfer omits the amount.
cases.text: Transfer MTK from the DAO Treasury to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 but do not assume the amount.

cases.description: Clarification/array alignment: one batch recipient has no specified amount.
cases.text: Make one atomic MTK batch transfer from the DAO Treasury: send 10 MTK to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111, 20 MTK to 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222, and also pay 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 but do not assume its amount.

cases.description: Clarification/array alignment: one ETH batch recipient has no amount.
cases.text: Make one atomic ETH batch payment from the DAO Treasury: send 1 ETH to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111, 2 ETH to 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222, and also pay 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 but do not assume its amount.
